business_problem: Achievo wanted to upgrade its traditional intelligent-customer-service stack, which struggled with intent errors, weak context handling and repetitive answers, even though the company already had deep industry knowledge and many delivery projects.
solution_summary: Achievo rebuilt its enterprise AI-service portfolio on Baidu AI Cloud to move from rule-heavy support tooling to generative customer-service products. The new stack combines Baidu's ERNIE large-model capabilities, a multi-turn dialogue engine and an intelligent speech engine, all delivered through the Qianfan platforms. Prompt-engineering and training toolchains are used to cluster and segment target customer groups, accelerate demand discovery and power agent-assist functions such as product-material guidance, workflow help and recommended talk tracks. Large-model summarization and entity-understanding features analyze whole conversation histories instead of isolated turns, which improves compliance insight, risk detection and response quality. Achievo also launched an intelligent data assistant that lets business users generate reports through natural-language interaction, turning the same foundation into an internal analytics product. In effect, Baidu's models became a shared service layer for both customer-facing and management-facing AI applications.

data_flow: Customer conversations and target-group data feed the Qianfan training and prompt-engineering stack, which powers agent-assist responses and compliance analysis; business users then query the same model foundation through the Intelligent Data Assistant to generate reports and decisions.
business_outcome: Achievo upgraded its support products from scripted automation to context-aware generative AI, improved service quality and created a second internal-use analytics assistant on the same model foundation.
